article.title: Right of executor to recover tax paid.
article.content: The provisions of section 162 shall, so far as may be, apply in the case of an executor in respect of tax paid or payable by him as they apply in the case of a representative assessee.
article.html:
169Right of executor to recover tax paid.

Section 169 · Chapter XV · E.—Executors · page 682 of the Act

The provisions of section 162 shall, so far as may be, apply in the case of an executor in respect of tax paid or payable by him as they apply in the case of a representative assessee.
